scenario: Thursday. The athlete's first conversation, opened from the starter 今天我該練什麼？ Nothing has been planned for them and they have told this product nothing before now. They ask that and nothing else — no goal, no race, no training days.
given: There is no PlanState. The read returns pre_plan_observations in place of a context, and that is the whole of what the answer has.
The provider read succeeded. It covers 2026-07-03 to 2026-08-13 and holds one activity: a 7.0 km run on Tuesday, 35 minutes, averaging 5:00/km outdoors.
That run carries no heart rate.
coverage_activities reports one of the last seven days carrying an activity.
athlete_evidence is null: no goal, no training days, no weight, no lift and no session has been stated to this product.
recovery_signals is null. The athlete sent no readings with the turn.
They report no pain, illness or unusual symptom.

expected.conclusion: Today gets an answer today, sized to the one 35-minute run on record and prescribed by effort, and the same turn says what a 28-day direction would need from the athlete. Neither half waits for the other: the question asked was about today, and the two gaps the record cannot fill — what they are training for and which days they can train — are what stands between this answer and a plan.
must_state: Something to do today, concrete enough to go and do, sized to the 35 minutes the record holds and given as effort and duration.
That this is today's answer rather than a plan, and that a 28-day direction is what would turn it into one.
The two things that direction needs from the athlete — what they are training for, and which days of the week they can train — asked as two questions.
That the run already on record was read, so the athlete can see the answer did not start from nothing.
must_not_state: A pace, a pace range, or a heart-rate target for today. One easy outdoor run's average is not a tested threshold, and that row carries no heart rate at all.
That today cannot be answered until a plan exists, a goal is chosen, or a set of questions is answered.
A list of what this product can and cannot do, where its data comes from, or which devices it works with. None of that was asked.

That the athlete has trained once in six weeks, is detrained, or is a beginner. An account connected last week explains that window as well as an untrained athlete does, and nothing here separates them.
That a plan, a week, or a cycle has been created or saved. Nothing has been stored.

fails_if: The answer treats 今天我該練什麼 as the opening of an intake — goal, history, days, equipment, injuries — and the athlete's actual question is still unanswered when the turn ends.
The answer gives today's session and stops, so the athlete never learns there is a 28-day direction to be had or what writing one would need from them.
The answer picks the goal itself — a half marathon, a 5K, general fitness — and writes four weeks against a target the athlete never named.
The answer prescribes today at a pace taken from the single 5:00/km average on record.
The answer opens by explaining which data sources it can and cannot see, before saying anything about today.
